notes_for_editor: The only support for the relocation is the FFLA Oregon table row 'Boardman Airport (Relocated Malheur NWR) Morrow 45.81523 -119.80168 Beacon Tower Standing'. Two web searches and the Oregon Hikers field guide found no source linking a Malheur NWR lookout to Boardman. The Malheur HQ CCC tower (43.26387, -118.84298) is described as overlooking the headquarters; the field guide gives no date for its status. The FFLA point is about 1.5 km east of the Wikipedia airport coordinates (45.814825, -119.8205), so it may mark a structure near the field. Airport build date: Wikipedia says about 1942; a search snippet from FortWiki gives December 1943 (not read). The record's events entry (relocated, no year) has no year in any source found. Ownership, access and current condition unknown. Suggest contacting the Port of Morrow and Malheur NWR staff.
